projects.title: Selected work
projects.intro: Client websites I built as a freelancer, most of them together with the Apex Webcraft studio in Ukraine, and the internal tools I build at my jobs.

featured.name: Landing pages for a business school
featured.summary: Responsive landing pages for the marketing campaigns of Alex Yanovsky Higher School of Management.
featured.detail: I connected payment gateways and third-party APIs, built a set of reusable components so new pages launched faster, and tuned performance, SEO and cross-browser support.

projects.hosted: Hosted in Ukraine: from abroad the site may load a little slower.

cases.name: Christmas Tree
cases.summary: An online store for a Ukrainian manufacturer of artificial Christmas trees: collections, choosing a tree by height, product pages and a separate offer for wholesale buyers.
role: Development of the store front end and catalogue
Collections, height filter, favourites and cart
Responsive layout, fast pages, cookie consent with separate choices

cases.name: ApexDetail
cases.summary: A website for a car detailing studio: services that are easy to compare, prices right on the home page, a portfolio of results and a quick way to book.
role: Service cards, price block, portfolio and FAQ
Booking forms with a phone field, analytics

cases.name: Apex Webcraft
cases.summary: The website of the web studio I work with as a freelancer: cases, services, prices and a blog, built to bring in clients from Google and AI search.

cases.name: Project setup automation
cases.summary: An internal web tool that downloads a website, localises its assets and links and turns it into a clean project the team can start working in right away. Designed and built on my own initiative.
role: Download layer with two engines: wget, and a real browser (Playwright) for pages behind a 403 or a bot check
Asset localisation: links are rewritten to relative paths, analytics and trackers are stripped, forms are redirected
React interface with three modes: whole website, selected pages, clean up an archive
Project setup from about two hours to under 15 minutes, 100+ projects set up with it, used daily by six developers

about.title: About me
about.text: I'm a web developer from Ukraine, now living in Hagen. I build websites and web applications and automate the processes around them: routine tasks, integrations between services and internal tools for the team. I started with landing pages for marketing teams, where every second of load time costs sales, so performance and clean code matter to me. Automation grew from the same idea: if something is done by hand again and again, it should be done by code.
